title: nazm.obligations/1
description: Every obligation of a checked program (N87, `docs/architecture.md` §7.88): each contract clause, each call of a function stating a precondition, each operation that can overflow or divide by zero, each index and allocation, each call through a function value and each call into C, with whether it is proved at compile time (and why), checked as the program runs, or unknown. Written by `nazm obligations --json` as one line; deterministic. Compiler evidence for a reviewer, not certification.

obligations.description: Function by function in Core IR's order, each by position.

witness.description: Why a proved obligation is proved; absent otherwise.
